title: Merge imagePullSecrets overlays and standardized hook lifecycle annotations for private installs
author: Ravi Kapoor
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in VPC and air-gapped environments requested stable, declarative ways to supply registry credentials per-tenant and avoid duplicate hook execution during upgrades. This PR introduces a composable imagePullSecrets overlay and a small hook lifecycle annotation scheme to make init hooks deterministic and idempotent across upgrades and rollbacks. Summary of changes: - Add values schema fields under .imagePullSecrets and .imagePullSecretsOverlays to allow global + tenant overlays and explicit mergeStrategy (append|replace|dedupe). The schema validates list/object forms to preserve existing installs. - Add a Helm library helper templates/_merge_imagepulls.tpl that performs deep-merge semantics for array-of-objects secret refs, with optional deduplication by name. Helper exposed to tenant overlays and chart templates. - Annotate init and migration hooks with hook.redwood.io/lifecycle (preinstall, postinstall, preupgrade, postupgrade) and hook.redwood.io/idempotency=true to provide a clear contract for orchestrators and for downstream operators to gate execution. - Update init-job and seed-job templates to consume merged imagePullSecrets and to honor lifecycle annotations. Added optional initJob.imagePullSecrets override. - Add helm-unittest cases covering overlay merging, dedupe, and lifecycle annotation propagation. - Update README and upgrade notes with migration guidance and an example Helm values overlay. Backwards compatibility: default mergeStrategy is "append" (preserves previous behavior). For clusters relying on exact ordering or deduplication, operators can set mergeStrategy: "dedupe" or explicitly replace. Migration: no runtime migration required—chart will read older installs and merge at template render time. Testing: unit tests (helm-unittest), local upgrade smoke with kind clusters, CI runs lint/test chart and a simulated tenant overlay render. The lint pipeline initially failed on a go-template lint rule; fixed by escaping pipeline on helpers and re-ran CI. Impact: Improves onboarding for air-gapped customers by centralizing registry credential handling while reducing accidental double-run of hooks during release rollouts. Extra notes: keep hook lifecycle annotations stable (semver-major only if we change keys), documented upgrade steps in the chart README.
commits: add helm helper _merge_imagepulls.tpl and unit tests
extend values.schema.json with imagePullSecrets overlays and mergeStrategy
annotate hooks with hook.redwood.io/lifecycle and idempotency flag
consume merged secrets in init-job and seed-job templates
update README and add upgrade migration notes
review_comments: Asha Menon: Please ensure default mergeStrategy preserves existing behavior for non-overlaid installs — otherwise this looks good.
Ravi Kapoor: Responded — default is "append" to preserve ordering; added unit test for legacy values form.
Diego Alvarez: Requested change — prefer dedupe by .name instead of full object equality; added dedupe-by-name option and test.
CI: Initial helm-lint failed on missing quote escape in helper; fixed and re-ran — all checks passed.
release_notes: Add support for per-tenant imagePullSecrets overlays and stable hook lifecycle annotations. Default merge strategy preserves current behavior; operators can opt into dedupe or replace. See chart README for upgrade steps and examples.
notes_for_ops: No runtime DB migration required. Operators using custom hook orchestration should map hook.redwood.io/lifecycle to their controller. To enable dedupe set imagePullSecrets.mergeStrategy to 'dedupe' in tenant overlay.
